comment: Tests and homework are almost identical to what is done in class. Isn't the best at explaining things but is willing to take questions or explain further. Easy class for phys131

This teacher was maybe a 6.7/10 overall but 9/10 funny guy. His teaching is very confusing and some of the in class exercises were very difficult but the exams and labs were super easy. He is one of those profs that will try to teach you everything and lot of it but only test you on the easy stuff which could get annoying.
